verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 12.38
4. Kaḷārakhattiyavagga
Cetanāsutta
Sāvatthiyaṁ viharati.
“Yañca, bhikkhave, ceteti yañca pakappeti yañca anuseti, ārammaṇametaṁ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, what you intend or plan, and what you have underlying tendencies for become a support for the continuation of consciousness.

verses.pali: Ārammaṇe sati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa hoti.
verses.english: When this support exists, consciousness becomes established.

verses.pali: Tasmiṁ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti.
verses.english: When consciousness is established and grows, there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbattiyā sati āyatiṁ jāti jarāmaraṇaṁ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
verses.english: When there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future, future rebirth, old age, and death come to be, as do sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress.

verses.pali: Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
verses.english: That is how this entire mass of suffering originates.

verses.pali: No ce, bhikkhave, ceteti no ce pakappeti, atha ce anuseti, ārammaṇametaṁ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
verses.english: If you don’t intend or plan, but still have underlying tendencies, this becomes a support for the continuation of consciousness.

verses.pali: Ārammaṇe sati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa hoti.
verses.english: When this support exists, consciousness becomes established.

verses.pali: Tasmiṁ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti.
verses.english: When consciousness is established and grows, there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbattiyā sati āyatiṁ jāti jarāmaraṇaṁ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
verses.english: When there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future, future rebirth, old age, and death come to be, as do sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress.

verses.pali: Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
verses.english: That is how this entire mass of suffering originates.

verses.pali: Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, no ceva ceteti no ca pakappeti no ca anuseti, ārammaṇametaṁ na hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā.
verses.english: If you don’t intend or plan or have underlying tendencies, this doesn’t become a support for the continuation of consciousness.

verses.pali: Ārammaṇe asati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
verses.english: With no support, consciousness is not established.

verses.pali: Tadappatiṭṭhite viññāṇe avirūḷhe āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti na hoti.
verses.english: When consciousness is not established and doesn’t grow, there’s no regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbattiyā asati āyatiṁ jāti jarāmaraṇaṁ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
verses.english: When there is no regeneration into a new state of existence in the future, future rebirth, old age, and death cease, as do sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress.

verses.pali: Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotī”ti.
verses.english: That is how this entire mass of suffering ceases.”

verses.pali: Aṭṭhamaṁ.
